MUTATIONS: a lifecycle test's guard signals a child that is still running when it drops (#366); a guard whose drop does nothing leaves the daemon a failed test started running
the guard sends SIGKILL once the bound passes with the child still running (#366); without the fallback a child that traps SIGTERM outlives its guard
SCRIPT_MUTATIONS: a killer the runner ends takes its whole process group with it (#366); without the group kill the direct child dies and its test binary's children run on
the killer leads a process group of its own, so the group kill reaches its descendants and never the runner's own (#366)
any way out of a killer run other than its timeout, an interrupt for one, still ends the killer's group while its leader runs (#366)
a SIGTERM of the runner, to its pid or its group, ends it through its cleanup so the killer's group ends too (#409); without the handler the default action leaves the group running
a timed-out killer returns at its bound whatever a descendant outside the group holds (#409); collecting its output after the kill waits on pipes the descendant keeps open
every way out of a killer run closes its stdout and stderr pipes (#409); without the close an interrupted run leaves both open
